serviceName: Tax Plan Experts SendGrid Email Domain
name: Tax Plan Experts SendGrid Email Domain
description: Publishes the three SendGrid CNAME records required to authenticate a custom no-reply@ sending domain for Tax Plan Experts. No mailbox is created and MX records are not changed.
variableDescription: %hostMailCname%: SendGrid return-path label under the customer domain (e.g. em1234); %targetMailCname%: SendGrid return-path target; %hostDkim1%/%hostDkim2%: DKIM selectors (e.g. s1, s2) used as %hostDkimN%._domainkey; %targetDkim1%/%targetDkim2%: SendGrid DKIM CNAME targets.
